name: Cedarwood Estates South
technicalSpec: Stone cladding with paint on cement finish, laminated glass balustrade, double glass with aluminum window frames, WPC fluted cladding and WPC ceiling panel. VRF-based ducted cooling. Fully integrated home automation.
